title: Google Flow Cinematic Movie & Audio Sync
description: Prompt tạo video 8 giây chuyên nghiệp trên Google Flow/Veo có camera chuyển động phức tạp và âm thanh đồng bộ.
author: Tôi Là Tùng
template:
[Camera motion e.g., Slow cinematic tracking shot pushing forward at eye level, smooth 24fps motion].

Subject: [Describe Character e.g., A charismatic Vietnamese man in his 30s with short black hair, wearing a dark grey linen shirt], perfect face lock, consistent lighting and shadows.

Action sequence with precise timing:
0-2s: [Describe action 1, e.g., looks directly at the camera, smiling warm and confidently].
2-5s: [Describe action 2, e.g., raises his hand slightly as if explaining a concept, natural body weight shift].
5-8s: [Describe action 3, e.g., lowers hand, nods gently, maintaining a friendly expression].

Setting: [Describe environment, e.g., A modern high-tech workspace, soft blurred server racks in the background with purple and cyan ambient lights], shallow depth of field, beautiful bokeh.

Style/Lighting: High-end cinematic lighting, soft key light on subject's face, realistic skin texture and hair strands.

Audio:
0-3s - Subject says in warm, confident tone: "[Insert Dialogue e.g., AI Agent không chỉ là công cụ, nó là cộng sự của bạn.]"
3-8s - SFX: [Insert SFX e.g., subtle keyboard typing sound, light server hum].
Background music: Low ambient electronic pads, premium and inspiring atmosphere.
(Strictly no subtitles, no on-screen text. Perfect lip synchronization.)
